Remark
[nonnegative curvature of compact symmetric spaces]

Source: petersen:page-0406 ↗ rem:pet-ch10-exercise-jacobi-fields-eigenvector 1. ch10:10.5.4Let $M$ be a symmetric space. (1) Show directly that if $M$ is compact then $\sec \ge 0$ (hint: argue by contradiction, producing an unbounded Jacobi field along a geodesic). (2) Show that if $c$ is a closed geodesic then $R(\cdot ,\dot c)\dot c$ has no negative eigenvalues. (3) Show that if $\operatorname {Ric}>0$ then $\sec \ge 0$.
